integrity: The proof derives the intersection-count discriminant from the square-coordinate quotient, proves quasihomogeneity locally using the conic pencil and simple tangencies, then applies the cited addition theorem. The accompanying checker replays the exact finite parameter geometry but is not independent validation.
scientific_limitations: The classification concerns only smooth diagonal conics in the coordinate-sign invariant subspace. It does not classify non-diagonal additions. The general addition theorem is imported from the cited source; the new contribution is the exact parameter stratification and its consequences.
title: A complete freeness phase diagram for diagonal additions to Măcinic’s Example 4.1
